name: multi-modality-export
description: Project-wide multi-modality de-identification. Configure the sensitive fields once, review the exact before/after value table, then export: DICOM tags follow PS3.15 Annex E Table E.1-1 and the same values are rewritten in every Excel file and redacted in every PDF (text + OCR layers). Works for projects without any DICOM data by harvesting the values of user-created patients from the project tree.
author: pmt
